summary: Wrote a 5-phase, ~5-hour plan adopting the deferred/buffered audit-write direction over the skill-tag-narrowing fallback: pg_grant_mint and pg_grant_consume buffer their audit records inside the already-self-ignoring grant directory, and a new pg_audit_flush drains them from the already-registered Stop/SubagentStop hook. The plan records the adoption reason, states the minted-but-unconsumed audit guarantee as a construction property (pg_grant_revoke deletes only the grant token; the flush is unconditional), covers the push_grant_consumed loop in the same mechanism, and keeps runtime-file-patterns.sh and orchestrator-runtime-files.md out of scope. Every non-final Tier Justification names a suite subset measured in-session via suite_selection_select; validate-artifact.sh passes with 0 warnings and the harvested file_scope is disjoint from all four concurrent siblings.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan deferring push-grant audit writes to a Stop-hook flush so no mint dirties a tracked file ahead of a command precondition read.
